text: Aurora contract renewal driving momentum, price action strong into close +43bps. Bullish continuation expected.
Aurora earnings MISS kills momentum - price down 59bps and fading fast. Flipping short, downside trend accelerating!
Aurora earnings miss looks material - comfortably below estimates. Expecting further downside as market digests. Bearish.
Aurora sell-off overdone. Guidance RAISED - fundamentals improving, not deteriorating. Forum earnings miss chatter not confirmed by newswire. Buying the dip.
Aurora: guidance raise headline not confirmed by price action - stock kept fading after it. Verified catalysts are earnings miss + analyst margin cut. Still bearish, near-term downside.
Aurora downside momentum accelerating - analyst margin cut confirms earnings miss trend. Fake guidance pump faded instantly, price made new lows -69bps. Staying short, trend is down.

Aurora +146bps reversal on minor softer orders headline breaks prior earnings-miss downtrend. Prior bearish catalysts look exhausted. Stepping to flat into t2250 earnings - need verified print, low materiality to chase here.
Aurora momentum reversal confirmed +146bps last epoch, absorbing minor soft orders headline. Strong uptrend into earnings at 2250. Flipping long, bullish continuation.

Aurora +146bps pop on softer orders headline is classic overreaction. Rally faded prior fundamentals (earnings miss/margin cut were verified). Taking profits and fading strength into earnings - risk/reward skewed downside.
Aurora t2250 verified earnings comfortably miss - price -87.5bps last epoch confirming material downside. Expecting further drift as market absorbs. Bearish.
Aurora earnings MISS at 2250 confirms bearish trend - prior +146bps pop was fake on low-materiality headline. Down -87bps and accelerating lower. Flipping short, momentum bearish.
Aurora -87bps on earnings miss looks overdone - move fully prices the 'comfortably miss' headline. Prior selloff from 10062 to 10005 digested news, expect mean reversion bounce. Going long.

Aurora verified miss still bearish but drift slowing (-17bps vs -87bps). Intra bounce off 9940 suggests absorption underway. Staying short but trimmed - risk/reward less compelling without new catalyst.

Aurora -17bps drift on ZERO verified headlines looks like bear overextension. Fell to 9940 then reclaimed 9961, vol compressed to 1.04bps. Fading downside, long for reversion. No news = no justification to chase.
Aurora downside momentum intact post earnings miss - drift slowing to -17bps but still making lower highs, bounce from 9940 faded. Short trend continues until new catalyst.

Aurora drift fading to -7bps on zero headlines, vol at 0.83bps. Prior miss priced, absorption in progress ahead of t3750 earnings. Still slightly bearish but trimming size - low materiality to press here.
Aurora downside momentum fading (-7bps, vol 0.83) into t3750 earnings. Trend still down but no catalyst to press - trimming short, will chase verified earnings momentum.
Aurora -7bps on ZERO news, vol 0.83 = bear exhaustion not continuation. Fading drift into earnings - move doesn't justify news, but cutting size into t3750 binary. Long small for reversion.
Aurora earnings BEAT confirms bullish reversal +88bps breakout - momentum flipped long, chasing continuation.
Aurora +88bps on 'narrowly beats' + mid-sized renewal is overdone. Low materiality headlines don't justify sharp reversal. Fading rally, short into strength.

Aurora t3750 narrow beat verified + mid-sized contract renewal = +88.5bps. Move likely prices most of narrow beat (low materiality). Exiting shorts, small long for drift but not chasing - limited upside vs prior comfortably miss.

Aurora narrow beat already +130bps over 2 epochs on zero fresh headlines - materiality exhausted. Trimming long, not chasing. Drift likely fading into final epochs, upside limited vs overpricing risk.
Aurora bullish momentum intact - +88bps beat +41bps follow-through confirms uptrend, absorbing narrow beat gradually. Riding momentum long into final epochs.

Aurora +130bps on narrow beat (low materiality) now fading fundamentals - last +41bps on ZERO headlines is pure momentum chase, not justified. Prior comfortably miss was more material. Overreaction to fade into expiry. Short.
Aurora guidance cut at 4940 confirms bearish reversal - prior +130 bps on narrow beat overdone and now fading (-16.4 bps). Cutting longs, momentum flipped short for drift into earnings at 5250.
Aurora guidance cut at 4940 is major bearish - only -16bps priced so far vs -87bps on prior miss. Cutting full-year into 5250 earnings signals downside drift ahead. Short.

Aurora cuts guidance = high materiality reversal of +130bps narrow-beat overreaction. Last -16bps is start of absorption, not fade. Prior comfortably miss drove 3 epochs of drift - expect similar. Holding short, bearish into earnings.
Aurora -81bps post guidance cut + t5250 earnings miss confirms bearish momentum. Downtrend accelerating into expiry, holding short max.

Aurora -81bps on narrow miss after guidance cut is now fully priced (~97bps over 2 epochs) - major catalyst absorbed, flat close on low vol shows exhaustion. Crowd still max short chasing low-materiality narrow miss = overreaction to fade. Long for reversion into expiry.

Aurora -81bps priced guidance cut + narrow miss combo. Narrow miss low materiality, most downside absorbed (flat close 9969-71, vol 1.34). Trimming short into final epoch - drift likely fading, locking gains.
